Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
17
jdt.

 jb.
 W.P.A. 12099 of 2023
 Mr. Partha Pratim Roy
 Mr. Mahesh Joshi
 Mr. Kajal Kr. Dutta
 Ms. Swarnaly Das
 .... For the Petitioners
 Mr. Chandi Charan De
 Mr. Anirban Sarkar
 .... For the State

Learned counsel for the petitioners refers to the status rep  submitted by the respondents and submits that though notification under Section 3(1) of the West Bengal Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948 was issued on 21 st September, 1995, compensation was disbursed in favour of the petitioners some time in 2006,
beyond the stipulated time frame.

entities.text: West Bengal Land (Requisition and Acquisition) Act, 1948
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The report is silent with regard to the date of declaration of the award.
Learned counsel for the respondents seeks two take instruction in this regard.
Let the matter appear under the same heading on 26 th June, 2024.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.)
WPA/12099/2023 on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154463025/
